June 5, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson
Stevens First Principles Investment Advisors decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 43.94% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stevens First Principles Investment Advisors sold 3,829 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 4,885 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $820,000, down from 8,714 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stevens First Principles Investment Advisors who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $949.31 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.68% or $1.31 during the last trading session, reaching $193.14. About 10.07M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 5, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
